notes.title: Version 1.25
notes.content:
All hail, brave heroes!

We've continued to listen to the community and make fixes to the game, including - 

- Fixed an issue with using the CTRL key to upgrade 100 skill levels at a time
- Fixed an issue where users could get stuck in the shop overlay
- Added some save data integrity checks to prevent data loss
- Turned off steam cloud sync (temporarily) 
- Fixed an issue with users not receiving the correct end of season reward tiers

Keep posting on the forums as you have been doing. We appreciate the passion you share for our game. 

Until next time..

notes.title: Version 1.23
notes.content:
Greetings, brave heroes.

We have released a new version which addresses the following -

- Added a button to the shop to restore previous purchases.
- Fixed an issue with the Next button not working to move between missions.

As ever, please keep the forum postings coming. Rest assured we absolutely value your findings and whilst we might not always post, we do review every one and take the appropriate action.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Version 1.18
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

We continue to improve the overall player experience. Here is what we have resolved in the latest version (1.18).

- Fixed an issue where exceedingly high level skills could cause a crash when triggered
- Fixed an issue where playing the game on multiple computers with Steam Cloud enabled could cause unexpected behaviour
- Fixed an issue where a user could end up in the state where they could no longer upload game data to the server, preventing them from entering Season Mode
- Fixed an oversight where the game was sending too much network data for no real reason
- Filtered some helpful users' data to bring their hero levels back inline with what they'd expect

Remember to Keep on clicking. Victory is ahead of you!

notes.title: Version 1.17
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes.

What's this, more improvements? Oh yes. Our small but dedicated team have today resolved the following bugs through the latest update - 

- Fix: Massive SP gain from high level crusades / timed / trials.
- Fix: An undisclosed SP exploit.
- Fix: Corrodus 3rd skill did no damage.

We have also - 

- Added Fullscreen Mode to game menu (click cog in main frontend menu).
- Added Resolution options.

All that before Christmas.

Now go, heroes. Click your way to success in the battlefield!

notes.title: Version 1.16
notes.content:
Another day and we've made another step forward in enhancing the overall player experience. 

Here is what we've achieved in terms of fixes in this latest build -

- Fix - crash bug when opening Inventory / Merchant when you have a large - number of high level items.
- Fix - Daily Login rewards getting reset to day 1.
- Fix - Missing textures on Shield Kid Brynn.
- Put in a temporary fix for Spiderbot Spindle Skill Accelerate.
- Added language change option in the settings screen (click the cog in the games main menu). You will need to manually restart the game for the new language setting to apply.

Keep the discussions coming. 

Click on, hero. Click on!
